passage.text: The mall is open daily from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmɔːl ɪz ˈoʊpən ˈdeɪli frəm ˈtɛn ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈtɛn ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: The supermarket is on the ground floor.
passage.reading: ðə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt ɪz ɑːn ðə ˌɡraʊnd ˈflɔːr.

passage.text: Fashion shops are on the first, second, and third floors.
passage.reading: ˈfæʃən ˌʃɑːps ər ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst, ˈsɛkənd, ənd ˈθɜːrd ˈflɔːrz.

passage.text: The food court is on the fifth floor.
passage.reading: ðə ˈfuːd ˌkɔːrt ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈfɪfθ ˈflɔːr.

passage.text: The movie theater is on the sixth floor.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌθiːətər ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈsɪksθ ˈflɔːr.
